pages.title: Acid-Resistant Fluid Pump Mk II
pages.text: The Acid-Resistant Fluid Pump Mk II is capable of extracting Precipitation Acid.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place the pump near a water source. It auto-detects nearby water blocks and starts extracting.$(br2)Extracted water can be transported via $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/pipe)Fluid Pipes$() to machines that need it.
